Text.Text: My vigil can end. Use the strength you earned for those who still need someone to stand with them. You've finished my Last Stand of the Light trials. I have no further work for you here.
Reach rank 50 in Force before you take these trials. I won't send another unprepared student into the crypts.

Students of the light went into the crypts and learned a corrupted rite. Bring me their tablet so I can see what turned them. Defeat six Last Stand of the Light Adepts in Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Their defeat secures the Last Stand of the Light Crypt Trial Tablet; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Starport. I'll give you the Korriban Sith Crypt Depths Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Last Stand of the Light.

Here's the Korriban Sith Crypt Depths Key. Use 'Sith Crypt Depths' in Korriban, Sith Crypt. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Last Stand of the Light Adepts, then return with the Last Stand of the Light Crypt Trial Tablet.

Because I led them here. Twelve students, seeking the oldest record of the last-stand rite, and I believed the crypts were only stone. The dark below was patient. I carry the ones I lost, and I keep this stair so it takes no one else unwatched. That is my penance and my post.

Use 'Sith Crypt Depths' in Korriban, Sith Crypt. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Last Stand of the Light Adepts in Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Their defeat secures the Last Stand of the Light Crypt Trial Tablet; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Starport.

They will not run. They believe they are standing their last stand, and that belief makes them fearless. Six adepts, any one of them stronger than what you have faced in daylight. Do not let pity slow your blade, and do not let the crypt goad you into anger. Come back up. That is the only order I will give you.
Defeat six Last Stand of the Light Adepts in Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Their defeat secures the Last Stand of the Light Crypt Trial Tablet; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Starport.
You've defeated six Last Stand of the Light Adepts. Let me see the Last Stand of the Light Crypt Trial Tablet.
The tablet gives us a clear account of their teaching. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists sustain the rite through a focus shard. Recover it before the corruption spreads further. Defeat five Last Stand of the Light Specialists in Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Their defeat secures the Last Stand of the Light Ritual Focus Shard; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Starport.
Your key still grants access to Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Defeat five Last Stand of the Light Specialists to secure the Last Stand of the Light Ritual Focus Shard, then return to me.

A focus. In our practice it holds a guardian's calm, so the last one standing does not stand alone in their own mind. The fallen refilled it with fear. Every student who died afraid down there is still in it, feeding the rite. I want it in my hands so I can finally let them go.

Use 'Sith Crypt Depths' in Korriban, Sith Crypt. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat five Last Stand of the Light Specialists in Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Their defeat secures the Last Stand of the Light Ritual Focus Shard; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Starport.

Stronger, and quieter. The adepts performed; the specialists believe. Five of them, and they will not break formation to chase you. They will make you come to the shard, where they are strongest. Breathe, keep your guard honest, and remember that you are allowed to leave. The dead were not.
Defeat five Last Stand of the Light Specialists in Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Their defeat secures the Last Stand of the Light Ritual Focus Shard; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Starport.
You've defeated five Last Stand of the Light Specialists. Let me see the Last Stand of the Light Ritual Focus Shard.
The focus is out of their hands. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden holds the deeper crypts for the fallen students. Recover the tomb sigil and end that watch. Defeat the Last Stand of the Light Warden in Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Their defeat secures the Last Stand of the Light Splintered Tomb Sigil; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Starport. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Last Stand of the Light Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Last Stand of the Light Splintered Tomb Sigil.

Toma. He asked more questions than the rest of my students together, and every one was worth answering. When the crypt turned them, he did not kneel like the others. He planted himself at the tomb door and let the rite hollow him out standing up. The dark did not break his stand. It kept it. That is what you are walking into.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Last Stand of the Light Warden fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

The tomb seal he was sworn to keep whole. It splintered the night the deep doors were forced, and he wears the pieces like a vow he cannot put down. Bringing it to me will not mend the seal. It will let me finish his watch for him, the way someone should have finished mine.

Defeat the Last Stand of the Light Warden in Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Their defeat secures the Last Stand of the Light Splintered Tomb Sigil; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Starport. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Last Stand of the Light Warden. Let me see the Last Stand of the Light Splintered Tomb Sigil.
The sigil no longer backs the warden's claim. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

Four keepers still authorize the corrupted rite. Take their token back. Defeat four members of the Last Stand of the Light Inner Circle in Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Their defeat secures the Last Stand of the Light Keeper's Rite Token; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Starport.

Your key still grants access to Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Defeat four members of the Last Stand of the Light Inner Circle to secure the Last Stand of the Light Keeper's Rite Token, then return to me.

Not my students. Older. They were down there before I brought anyone, waiting the way a snare waits. They studied our last-stand rite through the walls and rewrote it so that surrender looks like courage. My students only failed to see the difference. The keepers made certain the difference was hard to see.

Permission. Whoever bears it may lead the rite and choose who stands and who is spent. They pass it hand to hand when a vigil changes. Take it, and no keeper can pass the rite forward. It dies with them. That is why it must be all four, and why they will defend it past sense.

I would. Four keepers do not stand politely in a row. They scatter and reform like smoke, and one of them will always be behind you. You know your strength better than I do now. Just keep the rule that has brought you back twice: come home. Everything else is preference.

Defeat four members of the Last Stand of the Light Inner Circle in Korriban, Sith Crypt Depths. Their defeat secures the Last Stand of the Light Keeper's Rite Token; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Starport.
You've defeated four members of the Last Stand of the Light Inner Circle. Let me see the Last Stand of the Light Keeper's Rite Token.
Their authority to teach is ended. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

Their master is the last source of that teaching. Defeat him in the Final Ritual Chamber and end the corrupted school. Defeat the Last Stand of the Light Master in Korriban, Final Ritual Chamber. Report back to me here in Korriban, Starport; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Korriban, Final Ritual Chamber, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Last Stand of the Light Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

It means being the reason someone else keeps breathing when everything says stop. Not glory. Not defiance for its own sake. A door that holds because you decided it holds. He knows the form of it perfectly and the reason not at all. That is your one advantage, and it is real. You have people to hold the door for. He only has the door.

I do not know his name, and I have stood at this stair for years. The keepers called him only the master. He took our rite whole, the stance, the breath, the refusal to fall, and cut away everyone it was for. What remains is a stand with no one behind it, kept for its own sake in the dark. It cannot end on its own. Endings are the one thing he no longer knows how to do.

No. And it costs me to say so. My vigil is this stair. If I leave it, what climbs out while we are all below? I will hold the way open and the way home lit. That is my stand. Yours is at the bottom. When it is done, come up slowly, all three of you, and let me count your footsteps. It is the only prayer I have left.

Defeat the Last Stand of the Light Master in Korriban, Final Ritual Chamber. Report back to me here in Korriban, Starport; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Last Stand of the Light Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
My vigil can end. Use the strength you earned for those who still need someone to stand with them. You've earned the right to train Last Stand of the Light. Your final payment is ready.
Tell me the task again, quietly.
I'll defeat six Last Stand of the Light Adepts.
Why does a Jedi keep vigil here, of all places?
How do I reach them?
What will they do when they see me?
Not yet. Let me prepare.
Here's the Last Stand of the Light Crypt Trial Tablet.
Back to the shard.
I'll defeat five Last Stand of the Light Specialists.
What is the shard, exactly?
Where do the specialists keep it?
Are they stronger than the adepts?
Not tonight.
Here's the Last Stand of the Light Ritual Focus Shard.
Back to the warden.
I'll defeat the Last Stand of the Light Warden.
Who was he, before?
Would you recommend bringing help?
And the sigil?
I need to gather my people first.
Here's the Last Stand of the Light Splintered Tomb Sigil.
Back to the keepers.
I'll defeat four members of the Last Stand of the Light Inner Circle.
Who are the keepers?
What does the token mean to them?
Should I bring my companions again?
Give me a little time.
Here's the Last Stand of the Light Keeper's Rite Token.
Back to the master.
I'll face the Last Stand of the Light Master and report back.
Tell me what standing at the end really means.
What is he now?
Will you come down with us?
Not until my companions are ready.
The Last Stand of the Light Master is defeated. Here's my report.
